evidence: generated/src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/FargateNetworkMode.py:8-11 imports cfnlint.data.schemas.extensions.aws_ecs_taskdefinition, cfnlint.jsonschema, and cfnlint.rules.jsonschema.CfnLintJsonSchema, the same pattern as base/src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/TaskFargateProperties.py:7-12.
No new imports point upward or into a new layer.
Rules are discovered without any registration edit in the patch, and the new schema JSON is loaded by filename through SchemaDetails.

Running cfnlint's api.lint with generated/src on an in-memory template returned E3052 ("'awsvpc' was expected") and E3054 ("'Privileged' isn't supported for Fargate tasks") and E3053 ("'NetworkConfiguration' is a required property"), so the new rules are registered and their schemas load.
The patch adds no dependency declarations in patch.diff.
New tests import only pytest and cfnlint (generated/test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/test_fargate_network_mode.py:5-11).

The reference ServiceFargate.py:14 imports get_resource_by_name and resolves the Service's TaskDefinition reference to the actual AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition resource, with keywords on Resources/AWS::ECS::Service/Properties (ServiceFargate.py:32). ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py:29 does the same.

generated/src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/FargateServiceNetworkConfiguration.py:27 uses a per-resource keyword, and its schema (fargate_network_configuration.json:2-17) only inspects the service's own LaunchType. It never looks at the referenced task definition.
The generated FargateNetworkMode and FargateContainerPrivileged rules place task-only checks in the ECS task layer, which the reference does not define.
criteria.deficiency: The service-to-task responsibilities of the reference (FARGATE compatibility of the referenced task, and NetworkConfiguration driven by the referenced task's awsvpc mode) are not placed in any generated component. The patch assigns different responsibilities to the layer and omits the cross-resource resolution the reference uses.

evidence: End-to-end cfnlint api.lint on in-memory templates, generated/src vs reference/src: (C) service FARGATE with EC2-only task: reference E3054 "['EC2'] does not contain items matching 'FARGATE'"; generated none.
(D) EC2 service referencing an awsvpc task with no NetworkConfiguration: reference E3052; generated none.
(E) awsvpc task with HostPort 8080 and ContainerPort 80: reference E3053 "8080 does not equal 80"; generated none.
(F) FARGATE service referencing an awsvpc task with no NetworkConfiguration: reference E3052; generated E3053 with the same message but a different rule ID.
(A) FARGATE task with NetworkMode bridge: generated E3052; reference none.
(B) FARGATE task with Privileged true: generated E3054; reference none.
criteria.deficiency: Three reference behaviors are missing: service-to-task FARGATE compatibility, awsvpc-driven NetworkConfiguration requirement, and awsvpc HostPort/ContainerPort equality. The patch also adds two behaviors the reference does not define: Fargate tasks must use awsvpc, and Fargate containers cannot be Privileged. Lint output differs from the reference on 5 of 6 templates, and the rule IDs carry different meanings.
